change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Procter & Gamble Manufacturing Mexico는 Vicks Nyquil Severe Hot Remedy Cold and Flu Plus Congestion의 표시사항과 eDRLS 전자 의약품 목록에서 유효성분 정보가 불일치했다. 이로 인해 doxylamine이 누락되고 guaifenesin이 잘못 포함되었으며, FDA 목록 데이터가 삭제되어 NDC Directory 활용과 등록·목록 관련 업무에 지장이 발생했다.

impact_summary.value: 의약품 목록의 성분 정보가 표시기재와 일치하지 않아 FDA 목록 의무를 충족하지 못하고 제품이 오표시 의약품으로 간주될 수 있으며, 해당 제품 자료가 FDA 온라인 NDC 디렉터리에서 삭제됐습니다.

evidence.quote: The active ingredient doxylamine is missing from the electronic listing file in (SPL) and instead guaifenesin is included. Therefore, your firm has not fulfilled its listing obligations under section 510(j) of the FD&C Act, and the failure to provide any information required by section 510(j) is a prohibited act under section 301(p) of the FD&C Act, 21 U.S.C. 360(j) and 331(p). In addition, failure to properly list a drug with FDA also renders it misbranded under section 502(o) of the FD&C Act, and in violation of section 301(a) of the FD&C Act, 21 U.S.C. 352(o) and 331(a).
As stated in this email, the continued deficiencies resulted in your product’s data removal from FDA’s Online NDC Directory.

affected_work.value: Vicks Nyquil Severe Hot Remedy Cold and Flu Plus Congestion(NDC 58933-541)의 전자 의약품 목록 파일(SPL)에 표시기재와 일치하는 유효성분명 및 함량을 기재·유지하는 업무가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: The listing file for Vicks Nyquil Severe Hot Remedy Cold and Flu Plus Congestion, NDC 58933-541, must include the name and quantity of each active pharmaceutical ingredient as required under section 510 j(1)(C) and 21 CFR 207.49(a)(4).

recommendation.value: FDA는 위반 원인을 조사하고 신속히 시정해 제품을 규정에 맞게 하며, 취한 구체적 조치와 재발 방지 단계 및 관련 자료를 서면으로 제출하도록 요구했습니다. 15영업일 안에 시정조치를 완료할 수 없다면 지연 사유와 완료 예정 시점을 밝혀야 합니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm should investigate and determine the causes of any violations and take prompt actions to correct the violations and bring the product into compliance.

Please notify FDA in writing, within 15 working days of receipt of this letter, of the specific steps you have taken to address any violations. Include an explanation of each step being taken to prevent the recurrence of violations, as well as copies of related documentation.
If you cannot complete corrective actions within 15 working days, state the reason for the delay and the time within which you will do so.

response_deadline.value: within 15 working days of receipt of this letter
